llm_judge_details.justification: The core VNFs (NRF, AMF, SMF, UPF, AUSF, UDM, UDR, NSSF) are present, but the RAN element (gNB) and a PCF for QoS are missing, limiting completeness. VNF types and inter‑connections follow 3GPP specifications, though the missing gNB makes the AMF‑N2 link unrealizable, so correctness is mostly good. Resource requests are very low for the stated 200‑drone URLLC load and 1 Gbps throughput, especially for the UPF, indicating insufficient provisioning. The defined slice uses SST 2 (URLLC) with matching description, fully aligning with the use case. SLA targets (20 ms latency, 1 Gbps, 99.9 % availability) are reasonable, though latency is slightly high for strict URLLC, thus rated as good.
